summary: Example AutomationController spec constraining pods to specific nodes with node_selector (disktype: ssd, amd64, linux), topology_spread_constraints by zone with maxSkew 100 and ScheduleAnyway, tolerations for a dedicated=AutomationController:NoSchedule taint, and matching postgres_selector and postgres_tolerations.
questions: Example node_selector and tolerations for AutomationController
How do I schedule controller and Postgres pods on dedicated nodes?

answer_card.title: Pin controller pods to dedicated nodes
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
spec:
  node_selector: |
    disktype: ssd
    kubernetes.io/arch: amd64
    kubernetes.io/os: linux
  topology_spread_constraints: |
    - maxSkew: 100
      topologyKey: "topology.kubernetes.io/zone"
      whenUnsatisfiable: "ScheduleAnyway"
      labelSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app.kubernetes.io/name: "<resourcename>"
  tolerations: |
    - key: "dedicated"
      operator: "Equal"
      value: "AutomationController"
      effect: "NoSchedule"
  postgres_selector: |
    disktype: ssd
  postgres_tolerations: |
    - key: "dedicated"
      operator: "Equal"
      value: "AutomationController"
      effect: "NoSchedule"
```
